RjDj Revival
An independent Android revival built on ScenePlayer and libpd.
ScenePlayer copyright 2010 Peter Brinkmann.
Scene artwork, patches and music retain their authors' licenses.

Put on headphones, open a scene and tap Play. Allow microphone access to turn nearby sounds into music. Touch the scene or move your phone to interact.

Import a .rj, .rjz or .zip archive containing a scene folder with _main.pd and Info.plist. Scenes that require unsupported Pure Data externals may not play correctly.

Record saves the scene output privately on this device. Open the Recordings tab to listen. Playback continues with the screen off; Pause or Back stops the microphone.
Interactive scene. Touch or move your phone while playing.
Headphones on. Tap Play to hear your surroundings transformed.
Delete scene and all associated files?
No recording was saved. This scene may not support recording.
Microphone unavailable. Playing without microphone input.
Playback can only start while the scene is on screen.
To play this scene, allow microphone access in Settings. Then return and tap Play.
